## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Prague, Czechia. It starts at 194 Křižovnické náměstí.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Travel back to an era of knights and kings, exploring the tales of military leader Jan Žižka and the Hussites. Face medieval torture tactics and the architecture of the Old Town Hall and Astronomical Clock.
>
> Ascend to the second floor and find yourself immersed in darker chapters of Prague's history, from Nazi occupation to Soviet occupation. The journey culminates on the third floor, celebrating the Velvet Revolution and Czech global achievements.
